params.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS responses, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("推奨度" AS DOUBLE) >= 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS promoters, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("推奨度" AS DOUBLE) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS detractors FROM data WHERE "推奨度" IS NOT NULL

source.inline: function main(i) { const n = Number(i.responses); const p = Number(i.promoters); const d = Number(i.detractors); if (n === 0) { throw new Error('回答がありません'); } const x = (p - d) / n * 100; const nps = Math.sign(x) * Math.round(Math.abs(x)); return { responses: n, promoters: p, detractors: d, nps: nps }; }
